title: Windows 95 Year 2000 update
note: Historical date and leap-year fixes for Windows 95. Read the installation notes: the package may prompt to install Internet Explorer components.

title: DCOM95 1.3
note: DCOM runtime for Windows 95 applications that require it. Windows 95 only; use the appropriate DCOM package for other operating systems.

title: Windows 95 OLE 32 update
note: Historical OLE2 document handling, file-system consistency and stability update for Windows 95. Check existing component versions before installing.

title: Windows 95 DOS device-name fix (Q256015)
note: English Windows 95 / OSR2 fix for crashes caused by multiple reserved MS-DOS device names in a path. Not the Windows 98 package.

title: Windows 95 IP fragment reassembly fix (MS00-029)
note: Historical Windows 95 patch for malformed IP fragment reassembly denial of service. English package; read the bulletin for applicability.

title: Windows 95 AMD K6-2 timing update
note: For the documented Windows 95 timing-loop problem on high-speed AMD K6-2 systems. This is a targeted fix, not a general CPU driver.

title: Microsoft PowerToys for Windows 95
note: Original Windows 95 productivity utilities. Extract to a folder and read the included README/INF instructions; unrelated to modern PowerToys.

title: Microsoft Kernel Toys for Windows 95
note: Windows 95 utilities including Process Watcher, keyboard tools and Time Zone Editor. Microsoft described these as unsupported tools, not for Windows 98.
